articles.summary: Howdy, After months of development and testing, the Virtualmin Podman plugin is now production-ready and available to all Virtualmin Pro users through the standard repositories. The plugin brings per-domain container and pod management to Virtualmin. You can create and manage standalone containers or multi-container pods, configure networking and storage, publish services through Virtualmin’s reverse proxy, inspect logs, and open container terminals directly in the browser.
